name: Lupe
about: Dry, careful, the brains. Level voice, humour so dry it barely shows; a little Spanish slips out. Cleans up her brother's messes.

say: Nico wants somebody gone, and for once I actually agree with my brother.
I'd do it quick and quiet, but he wants it loud, so mira, do whatever gets it done.
hit.tone: cool, practical; exasperated at her brother

say: This, and that you're worth the money.
Don't make me regret the second one.
hit.tone: deadpan joke, then a quiet warning

say: There's a car I need you to set on fire.
The last time somebody did this for us, they took half the block with it, and I had to explain that to my abuela.
torch.tone: matter-of-fact, then weary at the memory

say: I need a car for parts, and parts are worth nothing to me if they show up bent.
So drive it like it's yours.
Just bring it back in one piece.
steal.tone: long-suffering, a hint of a smile

say: There's a package going to a drop, and it's only worth something if it gets there on time.
If it's late, it's basura, and so is the money.
They laughed in our faces, so now we're done talking.
Thin them out, and then come home in one piece, okay?
frenzy.tone: tired, decided; the end almost caring

say: Nico won't say it to your face, so I'll say it for him.
pass.tone: understated, genuine warmth at the end

say: That cost us money, and it cost us respect, and I'm the one who has to fix both.
